RooPlan Windows bundle — third-party components

This bundle uses the CPython 3.13 runtime and dynamically linked Qt 6.9.2
libraries with the unmodified PySide6 Essentials and Shiboken6 6.9.2 packages.
Qt and Qt for Python are available under the GNU LGPL v3 and other terms
listed in their upstream sources. See LGPL-3.0-only.txt and GPL-3.0-only.txt.
The Qt and PySide libraries are installed separately in _internal. Users
may replace them with compatible builds and debug modifications to them
under the LGPL terms.

Qt source (6.9.2):
https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/6.9/6.9.2/single/

PySide6 and Shiboken6 source (6.9.2):
https://download.qt.io/official_releases/QtForPython/pyside6/PySide6-6.9.2-src/

The Python runtime license is in Python.txt. The PyInstaller bootloader
license and distribution exception are in PyInstaller.txt.

The installer uses Inno Setup, copyright Jordan Russell and Martijn Laan.
https://jrsoftware.org/inno-setup/
